jobs.description: About Deutsche Telekom AGYou are at home in the world. So are we — in more than 50 countries across the globe. We connect work and life, and our products enrich people's everyday experiences. Deutsche Telekom is one of the largest telecommunications providers in Europe and the first choice in the gigabit society. We have the best network and 230,000 innovative minds. Become one of them.** **Products.Innovation.Experience. at Deutsche TelekomFor people who want to build more than products: real impact.At Deutsche Telekom, we develop digital products, services and platforms used by millions of people across Europe every day. Within our Products.Innovation.Experience. department, we bring together product management, engineering, design, data and AI to build experiences that are simple, intelligent and relevant at scale. We are looking for a Lead Design Systems (m/f/d) to join our Design & Customer Experience team and drive the evolution of a shared design foundation that enables quality, consistency and scale across Telekom’s products and services.** ****What We Provide **- Value-based innovation culture that unites creativity, responsibility and purpose.- International and diverse team collaborating across domains and locations.- Meaningful projects with global customer impact.- Creative environment that encourages experimentation and collaboration.- Continuous learning and career development opportunities.- Onsite in Bonn, Berlin or Darmstadt**What You'll Do **As Lead Design Systems (m/f/d ) you define and evolve the vision and strategy for Telekom’s design system together with Design, Engineering and Product leadership. You drive design system initiatives across cross-functional teams while providing expert design leadership and have further tasks such as:- Own and evolve components, tokens, patterns and guidelines to ensure consistency, quality and accessibility.- Enable designers, engineers and product teams to adopt, contribute to and continuously improve the design system.- Balance standardization with flexibility, enabling innovation within shared foundations.- Champion accessibility and inclusive design as core principles.- Identify opportunities to improve tooling, governance and workflows while integrating emerging technologies.- Mentor designers and foster excellence through coaching and knowledge sharing without direct disciplinary responsibility.** **What you bringYou hold a degree in Design or a related discipline combined with several years of experience leading large-scale design systems in complex product organizations. In addition to your experience in influencing multidisciplinary teams across Design, Engineering and Product you have following skills:- Proven experience leading enterprise-scale design systems.- Strong design leadership with the ability to influence without formal authority.- Excellent interaction, visual and systems design skills.- Technical fluency with design tokens, front-end frameworks and design tooling.- Deep knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design.- Strategic thinking aligned with business and product goals.- Outstanding communication, facilitation and stakeholder management.- Cross-functional leadership and change management capabilities.- Fluent English; German is a plus.Does this job sound like it was made for you? Then seize your opportunity and apply online.Applicants with severe disabilities who are equally qualified will be given preferential consideration.We look forward to hearing from you!

Tätigkeitsbereich: IT/TelekommunikationFachabteilung: Payment-related ProductsGesellschaft: Mercedes pay GmbHStandort: BerlinStartdatum: 01.06.2026Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.06.2026Stellennummer: MER00044HAArbeitszeit: Full timeAufgabenWHAT WE DOPicture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.ABOUT MERCEDES PAYMercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORKWe are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCEYou assess current systems, infrastructure, and business processes to identify improvement opportunities and ensure compatibility with new solutions- You collect and analyze stakeholder requirements to define solution scope and objectives- You architect the Mercedes Pay Digital Voucher Solution, detailing structure, components, interfaces, and data flows, and select suitable technologies, platforms, and tools- You create proof-of-concept projects to validate solutions and demonstrate feasibility- You work with an experienced team of Solution Architects as well as the company's Enterprise, Cloud and Security Architects to derive right-fit solutions- You facilitate the collaboration with external development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices- You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical details into accessible language- You document solutions and disseminate best practices among team membersQualifikationenWHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE- You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field- You have 5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, with a strong focus on software product development- You have practical experience in at least one of the following domains: regulatory environments, agentic commerce, loyalty programs, vouchers, digital marketing, or payments (including PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, or AML/KYC)- You are proficient in microservices, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, CI/CD), Auth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocols, alongside practices like Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and DevOps- You have hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, GitHub, and Datadog- You have a proven track record of implementing cutting-edge technologies within a corporate environment- You possess strong teamwork and good communication skills, with the ability to maintain composure under pressure- You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plusOUR OFFER TO YOU·       Modern and dynamic work environment·       Flexible and mobile working·       Attractive fitness offer·       Numerous employee discounts·       Excellent infrastructureThis is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:MER0003ZHV). Company ProfileCoherent empowers market innovators to define the future through breakthrough technologies, from materials to systems. We deliver innovations that resonate with our customers in diversified applications for the industrial, communications, electronics, and instrumentation markets. Headquartered in Saxonburg, Pennsylvania, Coherent has research and development, manufacturing, sales, service, and distribution facilities worldwide.The Finisar Germany GmbH, a Coherent subsidiary serves multiple businesses within Coherent. One focus area is the development of leading-edge high performance, high capacity optical front-end solutions for long reach optical transmission. A special field is utilizing advanced photonic technologies in support of driving highly integrated coherent products. Another focus area is high speed detectors, scaling up to frequencies of up to 100GHz, utilized in research and test & measurement but more and more in communication applications too. We owe our worldwide technological leadership to the profound knowledge and experience of our employees. This awareness characterizes our corporate culture - which is open and communicative and ensures trusting cooperation. Each individual contributes to the company's success with his or her knowledge and responsibility. The passion and commitment of our team are the engine of our company!Job DescriptionWe are seeking an experienced Senior Test Architect to join our team. This role focuses on test system architecture and optimization for coherent products, leading technical test projects for product development, and supporting both R&D and production teams.- Define the overall test strategy and architecture.- Design scalable test concepts for R&D and production.- Define technical specifications for software development supporting automated testing.- Evaluate and optimize test methodologies.- Lead cross-functional technical discussions and teams.- Support failure analyses related to test methods.- Drive continuous improvements in test coverage and reliability.Qualifications- Degree in engineering, physics, optoelectronics, or related field.- Several years of experience in test development or test architecture.- Strong background in coherent optical measurement concepts.- Basic programming skills in Python, MATLAB, C/C++, or LabVIEW.- Familiarity with RF test methods is a plus.- Excellent analytical and communication skills.- Strong English skills; German proficiency is a plus.  Your ChanceWe offer an interesting and diversified opportunity in an internationally minded engineering team of a market-leading high-tech company in the field of high-speed optoelectronic components. You will find a creative and productive work atmosphere in a flexible work environment that shares the desire to succeed and a fascination for technical challenges and technological progress. We provide the following additional benefits:- Flexible working hours- 30 vacation days (overtime on top)- Health benefits package including additional health insurance or fitness program- Financial support for public transport or parking spot- Bike lease program- Bonus and private pension schemeYour ApplicationIf you are interested, then please apply using the button below. We are looking forward to hearing from you. Feel free to contact Lisa Weiland at lisa.weiland@coherent.com for further information.

At BMW Car IT, a wholly owned subsdiary of BMW AG, we live and breathe software. We design and implement embedded aoftware for electronic control units of the BMW cars as well as related tools and frameworks. By delivering software all the way from the idea to the final product we lead BMW into the future of digitalization and mobility.

What awaits you?

- You ensure system stability for Linux and Android-based embedded platforms across software deliveries.
- You analyse and resolve complex issues related to performance, boot behavior, memory management, CPU load, and system services.
- Furthermore, you debug cross-layer issues across kernel, frameworks, HALs, middleware, drivers, and applications.
- In addition, you perform root cause analysis using tracing, profiling, and debugging tools.
- You examine crash dumps, kernel panics, ANRs, watchdog resets, and memory leaks to improve system robustness.
- Moreover, you develop proof of concepts, validation solutions, and automation tools for analysis and monitoring.
- You collaborate with cross-functional teams and drive continuous improvements in platform reliability and software quality.

What should you bring along?

- University degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a comparable field.
- Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in Linux and Android embedded systems.
- Extensive experience with Linux kernel, Android framework, system services, boot process, and resource management.
- Advanced knowledge of debugging, tracing, profiling, and performance analysis tools such as GDB, Perf, Ft , Perfetto, ADB, and Logcat.
- Experience in analysing crashes, memory leaks, deadlocks,   conditions, kernel panics, ANRs, and performance bottlenecks.
- Professional experience in embedded software development and quality assurance in the automotive industry.
- Very good business English skills; German language skills are an advantage.

Would you like to improve the stability, reliability, and performance of next-generation automotive platforms in a highly collaborative environment? Apply now!

Note: Please apply exclusively online via our career portal. Applications via other channels (esp. e-mail) cannot be considered.

What we offer in Ulm?

- Company car option.
- English speaking teams in an intercultural setting.
- Flexible organisation of working times & mobile work arrangements.
- Career development & continuous personal qualification.
- Relocation Services for our new employees.

Earliest starting date: from now on

Working hours: full time

jobs.description: About Delos Cloud:Delos Cloud, a start-up founded by SAP, strives to deliver a sovereign cloud platform for the digital transformation of the German public sector. The platform is an essential component for the implementation of the German Administrative Cloud Strategy (DVS) in compliance with all relevant data protection, IT security, and secrecy requirements of the BSI. Delos Cloud is a trusted partner of the federal, state, and local IT service providers and complements their service portfolio. Therefore, you will find exciting and varied tasks in an innovative and meaningful environment. For more information, please visit: www.deloscloud.de  What you’ll do: As a Cyber Defense Sr Specialist, you will be part of the Delos Cloud SOC.  Security is a fundamental pillar of our company brand and not just another cost center. With your experience, you will protect Germany’s only sovereign Azure Cloud and make a valuable contribution to the digitalization of our country.   If you want to use your expertise in a young and competent team to tackle a variety of advanced threat actors front and center – apply now!  What you’ll do:  You will focus on the following activities:- Continuous security monitoring within the Delos Cloud platform- Triage and assessments of security alerts- Initiation and execution of incident response measures Depending on your personal experiences and preferences, you will also support in the following:- Digital Forensics and Malware Analysis- Proactive searches for security threats within the Delos Cloud platform- Further development and continuous improvement of our detection logicWhat you bring: - Proven track record within the SOC area, ideally at detecting and responding to cyber security incidents- Practical experience in Security Monitoring & Triage  - Foundational knowledge in at least two of the following areas: - Incident Response - Digital Forensics - Threat Hunting - Detection Engineering - Malware Analysis  - Willingness to work in a 24/7 environment with on-call duties  - Mandatory: Fluent in German and English  #DelosCloud  We win with inclusionDelos’ culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. jobs.description: Is it your passion to optimize value across portfolios, systems and products within a global Cost and Value Engineering function? Then join our team as a Senior Cost and Value Engineer for Value Management and Value Engineering (f/m/d) and actively drive sustainable value optimizations in a cross-functional environment at Siemens AG.What we offer you- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a global standard- Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth - 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family - Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Appealing Siemens pension benefitsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.You’ll make an impact by- Leading and supporting Cost and Value Engineering (CVE) projects within Siemens AG with a focus on Value Management and Value Engineering:- You are responsible for leading value optimization projects in CVE (e.g., Value Benchmarking), in close collaboration with cross-functional teams to systematically improve the value of portfolios, systems and products.- You act as an expert for value improvement and interdependencies in ecosystems, portfolios and systems, and support our businesses in strategic projects.- You contribute your expertise in hardware/software-combined portfolios and systems to maximize business value holistically, considering customer requirements, technical feasibility and economic impacts.- Consistent further development of Value Management and Value Engineering methods in Cost and Value Engineering:- You continuously further develop methods in Value Management and Value Engineering and ensure their consistent integration with existing CVE methods (e.g., Value Analysis, Requirements Engineering, CVE Benchmarking).- You develop Value Management methods to make interdependencies across ecosystems, portfolios, systems and products, as well as their lifecycle business impact, transparent.- You develop quantitative value approaches to evaluate and optimize hardware/software-combined portfolios and systems.- You further develop and maintain an AI-based Value Management knowledge base for the CVE community.- Partner for Portfolio and Product Management and the CVE community:- You act as partner for Portfolio and Product Management functions within Siemens AG to identify and initiate CVE projects.- You promote value-driven thinking across Cost and Value Engineering and relevant business functions.- You are part of the CVE community as expert for Value Management and Value Engineering methods.Your success is grounded in- Education: A university degree with a technical or software-related background, e.g., industrial engineering, engineering, computer science or related fields.- Experience & Skills:- You have many years of professional experience in portfolio management, product management, value management or in comparable functions such as sales, business development or business-centric system architect.- You have a sound understanding of Value Management and/or Value Engineering, such as Value Analysis or similar approaches.- You have practical experience in optimizing systems and products, ideally in building technologies, electrical engineering or energy distribution.- You have a solid understanding of AI applications and how Value Management knowledge can be made accessible through AI-based solutions.- Ideally, you have already gained initial experience working with Cost and Value Engineering and/or Procurement Engineers.- Ways of working:- You have strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills and can quickly understand complex structures and interdependencies.- You bring a strategic and customer-centric mindset and can translate complex business challenges into sustainable value creation opportunities.- You manage projects and time effectively, facilitate workshops professionally, and support acquisition activities with confidence.- Knowledge of Siemens products and systems in Smart Infrastructure is an advantage.- Willingness to occasionally travel, approx. 20%.- Languages: You have excellent German and English skills, both written and spoken.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usEvery day at Siemens, thousands of processes take place involving the ordering, processing, storage, and delivery of a wide variety of materials, raw materials, and products. Our Supply Chain experts keep a close eye on every movement from A to B. How can our digital processes help us operate more efficiently, effectively, and adaptively? What challenges and opportunities do we see in shaping a sustainable future worldwide? Join us in finding the answers to these questions!www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/)  – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.occupation: Calling Pharmacy Students: Your First Step into Clinical Research - Internship Opportunity (m/f/d) (Pharmazeut/in)
jobs.description: Job available in 2 locations: Karlsruhe, MunichWork ScheduleStandard (Mon-Fri)Environmental ConditionsOfficeJob DescriptionAre you a last year university student or recent graduate who would like to take his\her first steps within a dynamic clinical research organization? Are you interested in learning fundamental skills to start effectively your career?At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.How will you make an impact?The 6 month internship in Clinical Operations is designed to offer you the opportunity to develop insight into clinical research, master your skills while conducting meaningful work within the team. The programme framework is crafted to allow you to grow professionally, learning invaluable skills to help you kick start your career!What you will do?As part of the Clinical Operations, you will work closely as a team, providing support and ideas for day to day activities. Your engagement and level of dedication will ensure that our project teams would receive the administrative and technical support they needs. You will have a mentor who will help you navigate through our organization and processes and receive the best support, which will ensure you are on your way to reaching your goals.You will need to be in the office three days each week, with flexibility to work from home on the other days.Being part of the Clinical Operations team, you will be introduced to many diverse parts of the company and to other interns across Europe. You will have a wide portfolio of exciting tasks to complete. Plus test your natural curiosity in providing administrative and technical support to the team proactively, educating yourself about the clinical research industry and master your skills to measure your business progress.How will you get here?- You are last year university student looking for an entry level position- Successfully completed 2nd state examination as part of the pharmacy degree (according to §1 AAppO)- You have the ability to handle numerous tasks simultaneously- You enjoy working in a team- You also have excellent administration and organization skills and the ability to prioritize and time handle various tasks- Results oriented- Demonstrate a positive demeanor and desire to succeed- Exhibits a high degree of flexibility in adapting to a constantly evolving business environment- English and German proficiency (minimum C1 level)Work Environment:At PPD clinical research services we hire the best, develop ourselves and each other, and recognize the power of being one team. We understand that you will want to grow both professionally and personally throughout your career, and therefore at PPD clinical research services you will benefit from an award-winning learning and development programme, ensuring you reach your potential.Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory with PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.Severely disabled applicants with the same aptitude will be given preferential treatment. / Schwerbehinderte Bewerber werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt behandelt.
